name: Get the Goblins Drunk
objectiveText: Bring the Fool's Stout to the Goblin Pit Boss . Fool's Stout (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: After finishing this quest, Kravel will have the quest "Report Back to Fizzlebub" available for you: https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=1122
after you turn in this quest (or the Get the Gnomes Drunk) you have to go back to Kravel Koolbeard, and he'll send you *back* to Crank Fizzlebub in BB.
This quest leads to Report Back to Fizzlebub (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=1122/report-back-to-fizzlebub), as does the gnome version.
im bout 99% sure theres no difference, i went gnome cuz they were rite next to kravel and gob was all the way on the other side, but im just lazy...i rly dont think it matters
replies: ''Just an fyi for Classic players: ''...all the way on the other side..'' is literally a 5 second ride on a 'slow' mount or an (approx.) 11 second walk without a mount in order to get to the Goblin Pit Boss Lazy is quite the understatement. =)

comments.body: What is the differnce between the two quests? Are ther any drawbacks, if i'm going to get the gnomes or the goblins drunk?

Unfortunately, it gives you the oportunity to do the zanzil mixture into fool's stout part over again, but it doesn't give you any xp and then it tells you to take the stout back to the racetrack and that's the end of it.  No one at the racetrack accepts it.
